title: Call a Timeout on the Pattern, Not the Score
hook: Coaches stop the run, not the blowout
description: Great coaches call timeouts on an 8-0 run, not a 20-point deficit. Here's how leaders can build the same early pattern interrupt into their teams.

title: Why Blame Makes Retrospectives Dishonest
captions: People hide shortcuts and near misses
Honesty is a function of cost
Ask how the system allowed it
One slip means a missing safeguard
description: Blame makes failure reviews dishonest. Learn why lowering the cost of honesty gets your team better information, and how blameless retrospectives focus on fixing the system.

title: Run Team Retrospectives Like Scrims, Not Status Meetings
hook: Hit every deadline, repeat every mistake
captions: Scrims review decisions, round by round
Pick one decision from this week
What did we know when we made the call?
Log it where the team will see it
Spot patterns before they get expensive
description: Status meetings track deadlines, not decisions. Borrow the scrim model from competitive teams and run retros that study one real call at a time.

title: Constraints as Strategy: Why Fewer Options Win
description: Why deliberately limiting options, with fewer priorities, fixed timeboxes and narrower scope, leads to clearer choices and faster execution than open-ended flexibility.

title: Tilt Management: The 24-Hour Rule for Leaders
hook: Never decide five minutes after a loss
captions: Willpower fails when you need it
description: Tilt is the drop in decision quality after a setback. Borrow the gamer's fix: set a rule in advance to wait 24 hours before major decisions.

images.alt: A darkened gaming desk with a controller dropped beside a keyboard, a monitor glowing with a blank defeat-red screen, scattered energy drink cans under dim light (Chase Arenella)

title: Why a New Tool Won't Fix Tool Fragmentation
captions: Every decision starts with a search
Without rules, a tool is one more place
Give one kind of info a single home
Redirect questions there for a month
description: Tool fragmentation isn't solved by another tool. It's solved by agreed rules for where knowledge lives and how it moves. Here's how to start small.

title: Why Winning Strategies Fail: Reading the Meta Shift
captions: Spot the shift while you're winning
description: Top players treat strategy as a moving target. Here's why success disguises a dying strategy, and how faster feedback helps leaders spot the shift in time.

title: Why Team Decisions Are Slow: Time Every Step of the Loop
hook: Your team isn't slow at deciding
captions: Late signals, slow handoffs, no review
Time each step of one decision
description: Teams blame slow decisions, but the delay usually hides in observing, acting, or learning. Time each step of your decision loop and remove the waiting.
